system.longDesc:
Capacity: 1 Slot

Your eyes have additional transparent protective “inner eyelids.” These membranes grant you a +2 bonus on all tests to resist attacks targeting your eyes, including bright lights, irritants, and so forth, and allow you to re-roll a failed test to resist such attacks, although you must use the results of the second test.

Game modifiers on this item: consTest +2 (tests to resist attacks targeting the eyes, off). Items apply their modifiers while equipped; switch the ones that are off on when they apply.
